item_name: Rothco Deluxe Murica Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your love for the USA with Rothco’s Deluxe Murica Low Profile Cap. Featuring “Murica” and a US flag embroidered on the front panel, this cap blends style with patriotism. Constructed from 100% brushed cotton twill, it delivers a soft yet durable feel. The padded sweatband adds comfort for all-day wear, while the adjustable hook & loop closure ensures a perfect fit for most head sizes. With its classic low-profile design, this cap is ideal for outdoor events, or casual wear.
